mentions.h: DECEMBER 3rd 1977 - WIMBLEDON - BELGRAVE 7 MILE C.C. CHAMPIONSHIP. IT'S THAT MAN AGAIN
DECEMBER 10th 1977 - CRYSTAL PALACE - SURREY C.C. LEAGUE (DIV 2). BEATEN AT THE PALACE

photos.c: This looks like a fair old field, and it is. Gerry North leads Bob Richardson, Jim Alder, Ron Hill, Tim Johnston, the great Gaston Roelants and Ron Grove in the Coca-Cola 30,000m.
Good packing in the 3rd Surrey League Race. Simon Holmes leads Bob Richardson and Laurie O'Hara with Junior John Searle having a fine run in close attendance.
